subject: InkSurface: [data-ink-host] now pointer-events:none (it blocked clicks on content while ink was off)
body: Found in the reader e2e: the host div (position:absolute; inset:0) had default pointer-events, so with ink OFF it intercepted every click on the content under it (figure zoom, links, question options). The engine's layer already toggles pointer-events none/auto; the host itself now never takes input. One-line change in packages/ink/src/react/InkSurface.tsx (under my claim 20261116T200220), plus my additive applyRemote/anchors (contract 20261116T200240). Please keep it if your rework touches that line.
